description: the server runs the new numbering code
steps: Run --next-number on the server over ssh
Confirm it prints the same number as on this Mac

description: the Metis crontab carries a weekly job tagged invoice-number-check
steps: Confirm one weekly line carries the tag

description: the dry run prints the email it would send and sends nothing when clean
steps: Run the job with --dry-run on the server
Confirm it reports the known 26015 duplicate and no new findings

description: a failed pull is reported as a finding
steps: Run the job's dry run with the pull forced to fail (for example a bad remote in a temporary copy)
Confirm the dry-run email names the pull failure

description: the job is recorded in the Metis cron manifest
steps: Read documentation/cron-manifest.md in jf-metis and confirm the entry
